review_brief:
# Review

## f2e717c7c250

The inherited generator advertised `n_keys=1..3` although both its canonical program and construction were fixed to exactly two header keys. The repair narrows that contract to two, rejects unknown or coerced controls, keeps the canonical program byte-identical, and adds the native `dominant_key_rotate` family. Its first stage forms the canonical union crop; its second stage counts the two key colors inside that crop and rotates the entire crop clockwise or counterclockwise according to the dominant key. The first two teaching examples exercise opposite branches. The fourth private query is a substantive 30x30 case whose crop spans almost the entire body.

Focused tests pass 16/16 both in the current tree and copied runtime. The bounded audit covers seeds 0 and 17 at every supported 2–6 demonstration count, ten 30x30 stress episodes, seven named rival rules, and 12 protected-Racket labels. The authoring preflight executed 40 protected-Racket evaluations across base checks and four source-bound parametric jobs. The causal witness replays the qualified program and shows that reversing the dominant-key intermediate changes the output. Public projection produced 16 independent one-query views; four first-turn cases passed 24 private-field invariance mutations and four positive controls.

## 95be702ec4db

The inherited self-check assumed uniform 5x5 frames and rejected several canonical 22-column examples containing valid mixed 5x5/6x6 hollow frames. The repair validates each frame from its actual bounding box, enforces exact grid dimensions and frame count, rejects ignored/coerced controls, and preserves the canonical program byte-identically. The native `selector_row` family places one one-based selector in an otherwise blank top row, computes the complete canonical rotational-equivalence matrix, and only then returns the selected relation row. The first two demonstrations select different rows in different equivalence partitions. Its fourth query is a 30x30 diagonal gallery of five framed shapes.

Focused tests pass 17/17 both in the current tree and copied runtime. A strict form-validation pass exposed a missing outer close in the counterfactual Racket resource; a regression test was added before the one-character repair, and all six retained programs now parse as single complete forms. The bounded audit covers seeds 0 and 17 at eve

scope: Accepted generator repair; finite reviewer evidence, no new maintainer execution

sequential_dependency.intermediate: The complete cyan equivalence matrix together with the one-based top-row selector converted to a zero-based row index.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Normalize every framed shape and compute the complete pairwise quarter-turn rotational-equivalence matrix.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Return the selected relation row from the computed equivalence matrix.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Step B indexes the matrix produced by Step A using the selector-derived row index; replacing that intermediate with the next row changes the relation vector on the selected case.

Supports 2–6 demonstrations and 1–4 queries; qualification and causal replay are reviewer evidence only.
